brief:
Maan Wire reported that a dense meteor shower will be visible across Palestinian skies tomorrow, Thursday. The celestial event will occur during nighttime hours, offering residents an opportunity to observe the astronomical phenomenon from various locations throughout the territory.

Meteor showers occur when Earth passes through debris trails left by comets, causing particles to burn up in the atmosphere and create streaks of light. The shower's exact timing and peak intensity were not detailed in the report, though such events typically provide the best viewing conditions during late evening and early morning hours away from city lights.
title: Meteor shower to illuminate Palestinian skies Thursday night
